siteClaimAfterIdentityRemeasure.body:
Zero wrong outcomes in 1,000 crash trials. Measured on ClawQL's lab build of celld (0.6.3 plus supersede and expiry fixes), on one host, with a 3-second lease TTL. Soak and board share celldLabGitCommit 36d53565… and celldSha256 5abb5d06…. During-call: 241/243 intent visible; 2 call_never_sent (egress never left the node), settled via effect ledger as no effect and no lost intent — availability, not durability. Availability: 18 of 1,000 (1.8%).

Open items: an earlier 3-second-TTL board recorded 2 lost intents in 100 trials. One was later classified as an injection miss (based on the journal, since the effect ledger wasn't kept); the other remains unexplained. Forced-latency tests are still in progress.

Availability tradeoff: remesure 1.8% vs first board 0.2%; 19 successful self-fences with resume p50 ≈17s (first board ≈6.7s) — consistent with expiry≠dead fenced-takeover wait.
